purpose: Optional provider adapter metadata. This config describes an executable adapter and does not approve or register calling agents.

privateRuntimeAuth.location: UCP_TOKENIZER_AUTH_JSON or an external secret manager
requirements: Exact merchant origin and handler identity
No secret or reusable payment credential in public handler metadata
No caller allowlist and no agent approval semantics

discovery.rule: Discovery can prove adapter identity; it cannot grant source, checkout, wallet, or private-host authority.
